info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: ' sattAyAM vidyate jYAne vetti vinte vicAraRe ' (Slo. 111) - devaH .

examples: 'kfcCrAllabDamaBipretaM yadi kOsalya naSyati. tadA nirvidyate so'rTAt pariBagnakramo naraH' (BA0 SAM0 104.40). nirvidyate=nirvedamApadyate, arTe vizaye labDavye virakto Bavati, nirIhaH saMjAyate.
'niravidyata DarmAtmA jIvitena vfkodaraH' (BA0 droRa0 132.20). jIvite vItaspfho'BUdityarTaH. nAtaH paraM jijIvizA'syABUdityaBiprAyaH.
'paSyantu duHKitAM kfzRAM sA ca nirvidyatAM punaH' (BA0 vana0 237.21). punarnirvidyatAm=BUyo nErASyamApadyatAm.
'sANKyayogaviBAgajYo nirvivitsuH' (BA0 saBA0 5.7). nirvedo yudDoparatiH, taM kartumicCanniti nIlakaRWaH.
'anirvedaH Sriyo mUlamanirvedaH paraM suKam. anirvedo hi satataM sarvArTezvanuvartate' (rA0 5.12.10).. nirvedo nErASyam. anirvedastadaBAvaH. ASABaNgasya virahaH.
'na cAsya jIvite rAjannirvedaH samajAyata' (BA0 strI0 5.10). jIvite nirvedaH=jijIvizAvirahaH. nAtaH paraM jIvitumicCAmIti budDirnAjAyatetyarTaH.
'tadA gantAsi nirvedaM Srotavyasya Srutasya ca' (gItA 2.52). nirvedo viraktirOdAsInyam.
'janmanA yastu nirviRRo maraRena taTEva ca. ADiBirvyADiBiScEva taM devA brAhmaRaM viduH' (SaNKa0 7.10). nirviRRo'Kinna ityarTaH pratiBAti.
'nirviRRasya padaM karoti hfdaye tasya svatantraspfhA' (paYcata0 1.240). nirviRRo virakto'paraktaH. svAminyaBakta ityarTaH.
'hfzwe jaharza nirvivedAnukUlyataH' (rAja0 6.262). atra nirvivide iti tu yuktam. videH sattAyAm ityasya tiNNantezu nirvedArTasya darSanAt.
'nirvidyati naraH kAmAdanirvidya suKameDate' (BA0 SAM0 104.7). nirvidyati nirvidyate virajyate.
